header.title: How to Clean Your Coffee Maker (And Other Small Kitchen Appliances)
header.description: This guide provides a simple, step-by-step process for cleaning your coffee maker and other small kitchen appliances using vinegar. Follow these instructions to remove buildup and keep your appliances functioning properly.

steps.description: This step involves removing and cleaning the coffee grounds basket and emptying the water reservoir.
actions: Remove the basket
Dump the grounds into the compost bin
Rinse the basket thoroughly
Run the basket through the washer
Put the filter back into the machine
Empty the water reservoir

steps.description: Combine vinegar and water in a 1:1 ratio and pour the resulting mixture into the water reservoir.
actions: Mix one part vinegar with one part water
Pour the vinegar mixture into the empty water reservoir

steps.description: Run a vinegar solution through the coffee machine to clean it, pausing midway for a soak.
actions: Turn the machine on
Let the vinegar run through the first steps of the process
Stop the machine about halfway through the cycle
Allow it to sit for 30-60 minutes
Complete the cycle
Use the vinegar mixture and the clean setting (if available)

steps.description: Rinse the vinegar from the carafe and run several water-only cycles through the coffee machine to remove the vinegar smell.
actions: Rinse the carafe out
Clean the carafe with soap
Fill the carafe with water
Dump the water into the machine
Run the coffee machine through a complete cycle
Allow the water to cool for several minutes
Dump the water out
Repeat the process at least two more times
If, after three cycles, the water still smells like vinegar, run it through another time or two

steps.description: Wipe down the exterior of the machine using a cleaning solution or soapy sponge, and clean the hot plate with vinegar if applicable.
actions: Allow the machine to cool.
Wipe down the exterior of the machine with a standard kitchen and appliance spray.
Wipe down the exterior of the machine with a soft sponge and dish soap.
Wipe down stainless steel coffee makers with vinegar.
Clean the hot plate beneath the carafe with vinegar.

steps.description: Repeat the cleaning process at least twice annually, or when stains and buildup occur.
actions: Repeat the cleaning process
Empty all coffee grounds out of the device
Rinse all parts
